en: A sepia-toned studio photograph of three young children posed between and on two ornate wooden chairs. The two boys wear sailor suits with dark collars and ties; the girl in the middle wears a light-colored dress and stockings, standing between them. The card has a printed vertical caption in French along the right edge that identifies them as the children of a crown prince. A website watermark, 'www.elia.org.gr', is visible across the lower right portion of the image.
